I told Dana in her thread that the only deadline on record is 21 December. Marcus posted it in #north-team on 14 October for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form, and nobody in the channel has changed it since.

I couldn't find any Thornbury account files in the shared files, so nothing confirms that date except Marcus's message. I suggested she check with Marcus if the tracker needs it confirmed.
